verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of diagnostic output, logs, or warnings explaining why GPU or NPU acceleration failed or that inference fell back to CPU. Hardware acceleration is mentioned (Hexagon NPU, "whatever silicon the device has"), and a community note says M1/M2 falls back to llama.cpp. Neither describes any reporting of the fallback or its cause. The "no silent move" claim covers hosted versus local routing, a different capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output
